'''Chapter 421''' is titled "Gear 3".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Animal Theater|Animal Theater]]: [[Nico Robin|Robin]] plays pool with a gang of koalas.

==Short Summary==
While the rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] try to escape [[Enies Lobby]], [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] continues his battle against [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] in which he activates his new technique, [[Gear 3]].

==Long Summary==
The details of the [[Buster Call]] are announced to all [[ships]] in the fleet; destroy [[Enies Lobby]] and capture [[Nico Robin]] again. On the [[Enies Lobby#Bridge of Hesitation|Bridge of Hesitation]], the [[Marines]] run in fear. [[Spandam]] retells his father [[Spandine]] saying how even the indiscrimination of Buster Call would not kill him. Just as he predicted, the bridge is excluded from targeting via the Buster Call. [[Franky]] is amazed by the sight, and Robin cannot stop shaking after seeing the horrid sight of the Buster Call in action again. Back in the [[Enies Lobby#Tower of Justice|Tower of Justice]], all other members of [[CP9]] lay still unconscious.

Under the tunnel, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Sanji]] rush [[Usopp|Sogeking]] in the tunnel. Coming the other way is [[Nami]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Kokoro]], [[Chimney]] and [[Gonbe]] who are trying to outrun the flooding waters behind them.

The battle with [[Rob Lucci]] rages on between him and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. Below them, the room they are fighting in is now filling up with water. Lucci heads up to the top, followed by Luffy. Lucci says he'll allow Luffy to go off to save his friends if he wishes to, but Luffy says his crew and the others will survive and that he will not take his eyes off Lucci because he knows Lucci would take the opportunity to kill them. Lucci expresses some approval of Luffy's leadership as compared to Spandam's, but tauntingly asks if Luffy will be able to follow through in battle.

Lucci launches himself at Luffy and the fight continues as Lucci throws more '''Rokushiki''' techniques at him. Luffy tries his hardest, but Lucci gets the better of him in every instance. Luffy fights on, claiming that if he cannot beat Lucci, he cannot protect anyone. Once again Lucci attacks, striking Luffy hard, Luffy can barely hold out, Luffy decides it's time for [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques|'''Gear 3''']]. Lucci is surprised at Luffy's technique which makes his arm the size of a [[Giants|giant]], he blocks and is hit by a '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques#Pre-Timeskip|Gomu Gomu no Gigant Pistol]]''' attack, which knocks him through the wall of the tower.
